# Francesco La Rosa

> Photographer and filmmaker based in Messina, Sicily, working across Italy and internationally. Documentary, cinematic and editorial visual storytelling — weddings, brand and commercial, fashion, food, events and motorsport. Works as a single photo-and-video production resource, shooting both stills and motion on the same project.

This is an optional orientation file for AI systems and crawlers. It is not a Google ranking requirement and has no confirmed effect on search or AI Overview visibility — it exists only to make the site's structure easier to parse.

## Identity
- Name: Francesco La Rosa
- Roles: photographer, filmmaker, videographer, director of photography
- Based in: Messina, Sicily, Italy
- Working since: 2018
- Languages: Italian, English
- Site languages: English (root) and Italian (/it/), full parity
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/francescolarosa.ph/
- YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@francescolarosa18

## Geographic footprint
- Home base: Messina, Sicily — also Capo Peloro, Milazzo, Catania, Misterbianco
- Italy: Milan (fashion trade shows), Sicily (weddings, events, food, brands)
- International: Prague (Czech Republic), New York (USA), Barcelona (Spain), Colombo (Sri Lanka), Hong Kong and Macao
- Available for destination work worldwide

## Portfolio hubs
- [Photography](https://www.francescolarosaph.com/photography.html): wedding, brand, fashion, food and event photography.
- [Videography](https://www.francescolarosaph.com/videography.html): wedding films, brand video, fashion film, event coverage, reels.
- [Weddings](https://www.francescolarosaph.com/wedding.html): documentary wedding films and photography, Sicily and destination.
- [Food Photography](https://www.francescolarosaph.com/food.html): restaurant, bar and food-brand photography.

## Case studies — client, place, medium
- [Atarashi](https://www.francescolarosaph.com/atarashi.html): event production coverage across three nights on the Strait of Messina — La Punta, Bellavista, Horizon (Milazzo) and Arena Capo Peloro. Photography and video from a production pass.
- [Cettina Bucca](https://www.francescolarosaph.com/cettina-bucca.html): ongoing fashion video and social content for an Italian tailoring house near Messina, since 2023. Includes Colombo Fashion Week 2025 in Sri Lanka, a WHITE Milano collaboration supported by the Italian Embassy in Colombo.
- [White Milano](https://www.francescolarosaph.com/white-milano.html): recurring fashion trade-show coverage in Milan — designer and buyer interviews, event recaps, vertical-first video.
- [New York Business Fellowship](https://www.francescolarosaph.com/new-york-business-fellowship.html): corporate and institutional photo and video for a New York City business program.
- [Aston Martin × Peroni](https://www.francescolarosaph.com/aston-martin-peroni.html): automotive campaign photography, Prague.
- [Formula 1 Barcelona](https://www.francescolarosaph.com/formula-1-barcelona.html): FIA-accredited paddock photography, Barcelona.
- [Smashers](https://www.francescolarosaph.com/smashers.html): photo and video for the first Italian Smashers burger location in Messina, built on a nightlife relationship going back to 2021.
- [Casa Irrera](https://www.francescolarosaph.com/casa-irrera.html): pastry and hospitality photography, Messina.
- [Club Barman dello Stretto](https://www.francescolarosaph.com/club-barman.html): visual identity and social content for a Messina bartending organisation.
- [Saints](https://www.francescolarosaph.com/saints.html): nightlife event photography and multicam coverage, Messina.
- [Dose](https://www.francescolarosaph.com/dose.html): nightlife event coverage, Messina.
- [Luxury Story](https://www.francescolarosaph.com/luxury-story.html): three-day destination wedding film, Sicily.
- [Sicilian Ceremony](https://www.francescolarosaph.com/sicilian-ceremony.html): cinematic wedding film, Sicily.
- [Ondrej & Dominika](https://www.francescolarosaph.com/ondrej-dominika.html): documentary wedding film outside Prague.
- [Fondente](https://www.francescolarosaph.com/videography/short-films/fondente/): short film, 2025 — directed by Tano Lenzo, DP and camera by Francesco La Rosa.
